execution_owner: HQ only; FUNCTIONAL does not launch Blender/Godot or run copy/integration

coordinate_contract.unit: one Blender metre = one Godot world unit
coordinate_contract.export: ASSET_EXPORT, GLB, export_yup=True, no camera/light/animation/context geometry; imported GLB is already Godot Y-up, never add a second axis conversion
coordinate_contract.root_origin: local (0,0,0); tree/shrub trunk contact, palisade horizontal midpoint at foot; preserve any exporter basis/ancestor transforms
coordinate_contract.materials: UV + POSITION + NORMAL; image-backed self-contained GLB; original source_color/PBR import, no new brightness/gamma compensation

representative_section.mapping: Broadleaf_A/B/C repeated twice at exact current trunk XZ and provider floor Y; uniform size fitted to existing representative tree height. Shrub_A/B at exact current shrub anchors, existing displayed height. Only replaced entries are omitted from old render batch generation; all source blockers, count, route and floor inputs stay exact.
representative_section.palisade_mapping: Current segment [-5.2,0.08] to [-6.15,0.18], current height .94. Imported centered local-X module fitted between those existing endpoints. Existing gate segment untouched. If base-height difference exceeds .12 world, keep old segment and report showcase-only.
representative_section.ground_mapping: Find exact CompactedDirt_ImagePBR material under imported FiringPad, require baked compacted soil/litter without a road stripe; bind its albedo and available normal to duplicate existing AuthoredGround material. GroundSample complete curved road/grass/litter transition is showcase-only. Existing shader, UV density, route/grass masks, color boundary, vertices and collision unchanged.

firing_pad.pickets: 19 current crest stakes,270 degree ellipse;90 degree entrance toward closest route; do not rotate or close the existing gap
firing_pad.integration_gate: Full exported deck/skirt cannot overlay the sole provider terrain without duplicate faces. Preserve the complete FiringPad as an isolated showcase unless it exposes a dedicated render-only crest subtree with exact existing ellipse/open entrance and no deck/ground/side triangles. This script leaves the full prototype showcase-only; no game rules or provider geometry changed.

writes_when_HQ_runs: isolated godot-candidate copied from current candidate, excluding .godot/.git/runtime saves
work integration_result.json with source hashes and structural checks
preserved: current candidate and live R8 bytes
risks_and_remaining: GLB and producer root hierarchy are not yet exported; named-root/bounds/UV/material contract must pass before any copy.
Existing authoring exporter originally selects MESH only; ensure named asset EMPTY roots/ancestors survive export, or integrate will fail instead of guessing names.
Tree/shrub shadows and occlusion, imported alpha settings, frame/GPU cost and normal gameplay need HQ's actual Compatibility run.
FiringPad full deck/skirt intentionally remains showcase-only because matching a real current floor cannot be inferred from a circle prototype.

UX must export named CompactedDirt_ImagePBR on FiringPad with baked unstriped soil/litter base; pre-copy GLB check rejects missing name or baked image. Image content still requires actual visual check.
ground_density_contract: Retain existing soil_uv p*.31 (3.225806 world units/tile) with map-camera finish or p*.40 (2.5 world units/tile) otherwise. Base texture has no baked road stripe. No GroundSample UV/world extent or FiringPad deck UV density is borrowed; no shader code or common color edits. Packed G roughness is not bound as R.

showcase_for_QA.hierarchy: Find each exact named root recursively inside imported asset.glb; preserve ancestor/export basis via relative transform. Hide common library; duplicate each selected root into a wrapper at indicated origin. FiringPad and GroundSample full meshes shown here only.
showcase_for_QA.camera: existing common ortho23.5/elevation44, same sun/environment; camera/light changes not required
showcase_for_QA.bounds: integration_result.asset.roots provides actual glTF/Godot-Y-up min/max/size, triangles, node counts and GroundSample UV density after HQ executes; not guessed dimensions
